games.name: Basic slap battles
games.desc: A fan-made game about slapping people into oblivion using different gloves with unique abilities. This game is very buggy and chaotic, so don't be surprised if you spot someone complaining about some bug or a glove that I'm pretty sure originated from hell itself. You earn slaps when slapping people, which are used to unlock new gloves. Gloves have abilities, some are passive, others are activated by pressing "E" (mobile players have a button). Shift lock is recommended. ANY FORM OF EXPLOITING WILL RESULT IN A PERMANENT BAN - don't risk it Credit to (slap battles ofc duh).
